title: Angels We Have Heard on High
description: Angels We Have Heard on High in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are anonymous. The English translation is by James Chadwick (1862). The tune, GLORIA, is Traditional French. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: An-gels we have heard on high Sweet-ly sing-ing o'er the plains, And the moun-tains in re-ply E-cho-ing their joy-ous strains. Glo_______________-ri-a, in ex-cel-sis De-o! Glo_______________-ri-a, in ex-cel-sis De_-o!

lines: Angels we have heard on high
Come to Bethlehem and see Christ Whose birth the angels sing;
Christ the Lord, the newborn King.
See Him in a manger laid,
Whom the choirs of angels praise;
While our hearts in love we raise.
